잠언-10-2.title: 잠언 10장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 10 Pr 10:1-32 . Here begins the second part of the book, Pr 10:1-22:16, which, with the third, Pr 22:16-25:28, contains series of proverbs whose sense is complete in one or two verses, and which, having no logical connection, admit of no analysis. The parallelisms of Pr 10: 1-15:33 are mostly antithetic; and those of Pr 16:1-22:16, synthetic. The evidences of art in the structure are very clear, and indicate, probably, a purpose of facilitating the labor of memorizing. 1. wise [and] foolish-- as they follow or reject the precepts of wisdom. maketh ... father-- or, "gladdens a father." heaviness-- or, "grief."

잠언-10-3.title: 잠언 10장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-3.exegesis: 2. Treasures ... nothing-- that is, Ill-gotten gains give no true happiness (compare Pr 4:17 ; Mt 6:19 ). righteousness-- especially beneficence ( Psa 112:9 ). death-- the greatest of all evils.
잠언-10-3.theologicalNote: 2. Treasures ... nothing-- that is, Ill-gotten gains give no true happiness (compare Pr 4:17 ; Mt 6:19 ). righteousness-- especially beneficence ( Psa 112:9 ). death-- the greatest of all evils.

잠언-10-4.title: 잠언 10장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-4.exegesis: 3. (Compare Psa 37:16-20 ). The last clause is better: "He will repel the greedy desires of the wicked."
잠언-10-4.theologicalNote: 3. (Compare Psa 37:16-20 ). The last clause is better: "He will repel the greedy desires of the wicked."

잠언-10-5.title: 잠언 10장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-5.exegesis: 4. slack-- literally, "deceitful," failing of its purpose (compare Ho 7:16 ). maketh rich-- (compare Pr 10:22 ).
잠언-10-5.theologicalNote: 4. slack-- literally, "deceitful," failing of its purpose (compare Ho 7:16 ). maketh rich-- (compare Pr 10:22 ).

잠언-10-6.title: 잠언 10장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-6.exegesis: 5. son-- as Pr 1:8 , 10 , and often. sleepeth-- in indolence, and not for rest. causeth shame-- literally, "is base" (compare Pr 14:35 ; 17:2 ).
잠언-10-6.theologicalNote: 5. son-- as Pr 1:8 , 10 , and often. sleepeth-- in indolence, and not for rest. causeth shame-- literally, "is base" (compare Pr 14:35 ; 17:2 ).

잠언-10-7.title: 잠언 10장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-7.exegesis: 6. Blessings-- literally, "Praises." The last clause is better: "The mouth of the wicked covereth (or concealeth) violence (or mischievous devices)" to be executed in due time ( Psa 5:9 ; 10:7 ; Ro 3:14 ), and hence has no praises (compare Pr 10:11 ).
잠언-10-7.theologicalNote: 6. Blessings-- literally, "Praises." The last clause is better: "The mouth of the wicked covereth (or concealeth) violence (or mischievous devices)" to be executed in due time ( Psa 5:9 ; 10:7 ; Ro 3:14 ), and hence has no praises (compare Pr 10:11 ).

잠언-10-8.title: 잠언 10장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-8.exegesis: 7. blessed-- literally, "for a blessing," or praise. shall rot-- literally, "be worm-eaten," useless and disgusting.
잠언-10-8.theologicalNote: 7. blessed-- literally, "for a blessing," or praise. shall rot-- literally, "be worm-eaten," useless and disgusting.

잠언-10-9.title: 잠언 10장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-9.exegesis: 8. wise, &c.-- (compare Pr 9:8 , 9, 16 ), opposed to prating fool-- or, "fool of lips of wicked language." fall-- headlong, suddenly.
잠언-10-9.theologicalNote: 8. wise, &c.-- (compare Pr 9:8 , 9, 16 ), opposed to prating fool-- or, "fool of lips of wicked language." fall-- headlong, suddenly.

잠언-10-10.title: 잠언 10장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-10.exegesis: 9. perverteth his ways-- acts deceitfully. known-- discovered and punished.
잠언-10-10.theologicalNote: 9. perverteth his ways-- acts deceitfully. known-- discovered and punished.

잠언-10-11.title: 잠언 10장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-11.exegesis: 10. Two vices contrasted; hypocrisy, or insinuating evil against one ( Pr 6:13 ; Psa 35:19 ), and rashness of speech. In each case, the results are on the evildoers.
잠언-10-11.theologicalNote: 10. Two vices contrasted; hypocrisy, or insinuating evil against one ( Pr 6:13 ; Psa 35:19 ), and rashness of speech. In each case, the results are on the evildoers.

잠언-10-12.title: 잠언 10장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-12.exegesis: 11. a well-- or, "source" of good to himself and others ( Joh 7:37 , 38 ). On last clause, see on Pr 10:6 .
잠언-10-12.theologicalNote: 11. a well-- or, "source" of good to himself and others ( Joh 7:37 , 38 ). On last clause, see on Pr 10:6 .

잠언-10-13.title: 잠언 10장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-13.exegesis: 12. strifes-- or, "litigations." covereth-- by forgiveness and forbearance.
잠언-10-13.theologicalNote: 12. strifes-- or, "litigations." covereth-- by forgiveness and forbearance.

잠언-10-14.title: 잠언 10장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-14.exegesis: 13. In the lips ... found-- hence, not beaten, as the wicked-speaking fool. void of understanding-- ( Pr 6:32 ; 7:7 ).
잠언-10-14.theologicalNote: 13. In the lips ... found-- hence, not beaten, as the wicked-speaking fool. void of understanding-- ( Pr 6:32 ; 7:7 ).

잠언-10-15.title: 잠언 10장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-15.exegesis: 14. lay up knowledge-- that is, as treasures for good use. mouth ... destruction-- or, "as to the mouth," &c., destruction is near; they expose themselves to evil by prating.
잠언-10-15.theologicalNote: 14. lay up knowledge-- that is, as treasures for good use. mouth ... destruction-- or, "as to the mouth," &c., destruction is near; they expose themselves to evil by prating.

잠언-10-16.title: 잠언 10장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-16.exegesis: 15. Both by trusting in "uncertain riches" ( 1Ti 6:17 ), or by the evils of poverty ( Pr 30:9 ), men, not fearing God, fall into dangers.
잠언-10-16.theologicalNote: 15. Both by trusting in "uncertain riches" ( 1Ti 6:17 ), or by the evils of poverty ( Pr 30:9 ), men, not fearing God, fall into dangers.

잠언-10-17.title: 잠언 10장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-17.exegesis: 16. The industry of the righteous is alone truly successful, while the earnings of the wicked tempt and lead to sin.
잠언-10-17.theologicalNote: 16. The industry of the righteous is alone truly successful, while the earnings of the wicked tempt and lead to sin.

잠언-10-18.title: 잠언 10장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-18.exegesis: 17. keepeth-- observes ( Pr 3:18 ; 4:22 ). refuseth-- or, "turns from reproof," which might direct him aright.
잠언-10-18.theologicalNote: 17. keepeth-- observes ( Pr 3:18 ; 4:22 ). refuseth-- or, "turns from reproof," which might direct him aright.

잠언-10-19.title: 잠언 10장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-19.exegesis: 18. Both vices must one day be known and punished, and hence their folly.
잠언-10-19.theologicalNote: 18. Both vices must one day be known and punished, and hence their folly.

잠언-10-20.title: 잠언 10장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-20.exegesis: 19. Much speech involves risk of sin; hence the wisdom of restraining the tongue ( Psa 39:1 ; Jas 1:26 ).
잠언-10-20.theologicalNote: 19. Much speech involves risk of sin; hence the wisdom of restraining the tongue ( Psa 39:1 ; Jas 1:26 ).

잠언-10-21.title: 잠언 10장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-21.exegesis: 20. Right speech is the fruit of a good heart, but the wicked show theirs to be useless.
잠언-10-21.theologicalNote: 20. Right speech is the fruit of a good heart, but the wicked show theirs to be useless.

잠언-10-22.title: 잠언 10장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-22.exegesis: 21. Fools not only fail to benefit others, as do the righteous, but procure their own ruin (compare Pr 10:11 , 17 ; Ho 4:6 ).
잠언-10-22.theologicalNote: 21. Fools not only fail to benefit others, as do the righteous, but procure their own ruin (compare Pr 10:11 , 17 ; Ho 4:6 ).

잠언-10-23.title: 잠언 10장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-23.exegesis: 22. it maketh, &c.-- "it" is emphatic. Riches from God are without the sorrow of ill-gotten wealth (compare Ec 2:21-23 ; 1Ti 6:9 , 10, 17).
잠언-10-23.theologicalNote: 22. it maketh, &c.-- "it" is emphatic. Riches from God are without the sorrow of ill-gotten wealth (compare Ec 2:21-23 ; 1Ti 6:9 , 10, 17).

잠언-10-24.title: 잠언 10장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-24.exegesis: 23. Sin is the pleasure of the wicked; wisdom that of the good.
잠언-10-24.theologicalNote: 23. Sin is the pleasure of the wicked; wisdom that of the good.

잠언-10-25.title: 잠언 10장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-25.exegesis: 24. it-- the very thing. The wicked get dreaded evil; the righteous, desired good.
잠언-10-25.theologicalNote: 24. it-- the very thing. The wicked get dreaded evil; the righteous, desired good.

잠언-10-26.title: 잠언 10장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-26.exegesis: 25. (Compare Psa 1:4 ; 37:9, 10, 36). righteous ... foundation-- well laid and firm ( Mt 7:24 , 25 ).
잠언-10-26.theologicalNote: 25. (Compare Psa 1:4 ; 37:9, 10, 36). righteous ... foundation-- well laid and firm ( Mt 7:24 , 25 ).

잠언-10-29.title: 잠언 10장 29절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-29.exegesis: 28. gladness-- in confidence of realizing it. expectation ... perish-- in disappointment.
잠언-10-29.theologicalNote: 28. gladness-- in confidence of realizing it. expectation ... perish-- in disappointment.

잠언-10-30.title: 잠언 10장 30절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-30.exegesis: 29. The way, &c.-- that is, God's providence sustains the righteous and overthrows the wicked ( Ho 14:9 ).
잠언-10-30.theologicalNote: 29. The way, &c.-- that is, God's providence sustains the righteous and overthrows the wicked ( Ho 14:9 ).

잠언-10-31.title: 잠언 10장 31절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-31.exegesis: 30. (Compare Pr 12:3 ; Psa 37:9-11; 102:28). earth-- or, "land of promise."
잠언-10-31.theologicalNote: 30. (Compare Pr 12:3 ; Psa 37:9-11; 102:28). earth-- or, "land of promise."

잠언-10-32.title: 잠언 10장 32절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-10-32.exegesis: 31. bringeth forth-- literally, "germinates" as a plant. froward-- (Compare Pr 2:12 , 14 ). cut off-- as an unproductive plant.
잠언-10-32.theologicalNote: 31. bringeth forth-- literally, "germinates" as a plant. froward-- (Compare Pr 2:12 , 14 ). cut off-- as an unproductive plant.
